topic: GTA 6's $3.79B day one vs GTA 5's $800M, and what 'one day' really counts
title: GTA 6's first day made GTA 5 look tiny #shorts
lines: How much money did GTA 6 make in just one day?
Back in 2013, GTA 5 made 800 million dollars on day one.
It passed one billion in three days, an entertainment record at the time.
Rockstar says it made 3.79 billion dollars in its first day.
That's almost five times GTA 5's opening.
32.5 million copies were sold before the game even came out.
And analyst firm Sensor Tower puts the total far lower, at around 2.36 billion.
So what does one day really mean?
description: Rockstar says GTA 6 made $3.79 billion on day one, nearly five times GTA 5's opening, but that number hides a catch. #gta6 #gtavi #gaming #gta5 #shorts
